Common questions

About home valuations

How is this different from an online estimate?

Online estimates are calculated automatically from public records. They can't see your home's condition, recent updates, setting or the details of your street. A valuation consultation is prepared by a local Realtor who reviews recent comparable sales and talks with you about your specific home.

What happens after I submit?

A member of our team will contact you to learn a little more about your home and schedule a time that works for you.

Do I have to be ready to sell?

Not at all. Many homeowners ask for a valuation to plan ahead, whether they expect to move in a few months or a few years.
